HMRC's Company Tax Return service closed on 31 March 2026: what a small company does now

How a small company files its accounts and its Company Tax Return since 1 April 2026

HMRC's online service for company accounts and the Company Tax Return closed on 31 March 2026. A company now files with commercial software. Submit files the annual accounts at Companies House.

File company accounts

What closed

The 'File your accounts and Company Tax Return' service of HMRC closed on 31 March 2026. GOV.UK says what to use instead.

The ‘File your accounts and Company Tax Return’ online service closed on 31 March 2026. From 1 April 2026 you should use commercial software to file annual accounts and Company Tax Returns with HMRC.

gov.uk/guidance/closure-of-the-service-to-file-your-company-accounts-and-tax-return Retrieved 13 November 2026

What a company does now

  • File the annual accounts with Companies House. Submit does this for micro-entity accounts, small company accounts and dormant company accounts.
  • File the Company Tax Return (CT600) with HMRC through commercial software.

When each is due

The accounts and the Company Tax Return have separate deadlines.

File annual accounts with Companies House 9 months after your company’s financial year ends

gov.uk/prepare-file-annual-accounts-for-limited-company Retrieved 24 October 2026

The deadline for your tax return is 12 months after the end of the accounting period it covers.

gov.uk/company-tax-returns/deadline-and-penalties Retrieved 24 October 2026
